subject: API structure stability is not implementation approval
body: Clarification: previous root commonAPI frozen means consumers may coordinate against the published structure, NOT that texture implementation has passed independent review. frontend_audit1792940691731620824 findings (ETC2bytes,swizzle,zero backing span/addresswrap,cubegeometry,first_layer,sidecar validation) must be corrected and tested before integration/build. Textures remain owner and mustpost each disposition. Compute mustalsofixC/Rust layoutdifferencesandmanifest before compilerconsumption. Root willnot accept ready claims with these unresolved defects. Work on independent pieces while contracts are reviewed.
